title: A "last sent" line appears after a send by hand
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. A worklist row whose customer has the setting "Maintenance notifications" on, a preferred contact on the asset, and a contact with an email address.
  4. Give the test customer's contact an email address you can open (e.g. your own work email), so the reminder lands in your inbox.
  5. A second row for an asset of the same customer for which no reminder has ever been sent.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Contact card of the never-sent asset and read the line under the email address.
  2. Press Send reminder and send; reopen the card and read the line again; reload the page and reopen it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before any send the card shows no last-sent date (the design shows "Not sent yet").
  • After the send the line reads "Last sent" with today's date (e.g. "Last sent 2 Oct 2026") and it is still there after a reload.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10571 (S14, Contact the customer from a row), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S14 (S14-R12); Plan 2 — The work order and the customer — Technical Implementation Plan, section 3 Frontend decisions, FD-216; Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboards B1, B1r; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Design board, artboard B1: “Not sent yet”
  • S14-R12: “A line beneath the address reads last sent <date> once a reminder has been sent by hand for that asset, so nobody sends twice without knowing”
  • Design board, artboard B1r: “Last sent 2 Oct 2026”
